Third-party notices for the document script runtime

The runtime bundle includes the LinkeDOM 0.18.13 worker and bundled portions of its runtime dependencies. The upstream worker is a single-file rollup and does not include a dependency lockfile or preserve a package-by-package source map. Exact upstream package declarations are listed below as version ranges; transitive packages are named where identifiable, but their resolved versions cannot be recovered from the worker alone.

Upstream source: https://registry.npmjs.org/linkedom/-/linkedom-0.18.13.tgz
Upstream package metadata: ../tool/parity/vendor/linkedom-0.18.13/package.json
Upstream artifact provenance and SHA-256: document-script-runtime.provenance.json

Declared runtime dependencies of linkedom@0.18.13:
  css-select@^7.0.0 (BSD-2-Clause)
  cssom@^0.5.0 (MIT)
  html-escaper@^3.0.3 (MIT)
  htmlparser2@^10.1.0 (MIT)
  uhyphen@^0.2.0 (ISC)

Other bundled dependency modules identifiable in the worker:
  boolbase, css-what, domelementtype, domhandler, dom-serializer,
  domutils, entities, nth-check
  Their resolved versions are not pinned in the published LinkeDOM package metadata.

Additional attributed code in the worker:
  he (HTML entity handling; adapted code), Sizzle (unescape helper), and
  XRegExp (regular-expression helper). Notices for these portions follow.
